description: Capital Gains Tax Calculator — Federal capital gains tax for tax year 2026 or 2027 (IRS thresholds): stacks long-term gains and qualified dividends on top of ordinary taxable income across the 0/15/20% bands, taxes short-term gains at ordinary brackets, nets gains and losses ($3,000 loss offset + carryforward), adds the 3.8% net investment income tax, and shows how much more gain could be harvested at 0%. Inputs: ltcg (required, dollars; negative = loss), ordinary (taxable ordinary income after deductions, default 0), stcg, filing (single|mfj|mfs|hoh), year (2026|2027), magi (for NIIT; estimated if omitted), state_rate (flat %, optional). Offline, instant. Estimate, not tax advice. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
